description: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center located in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards, optimizing operational efficiency, and driving continuous improvement in quality outcomes. This role offers a significant opportunity to make a direct impact on the lives of residents and the success of the organization.This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000. If you are a results-oriented leader with a commitment to excellence in long-term care, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the State of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Proven leadership abilities with a track record of successful operational management and quality improvement.
Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets effectively.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, based on experience and qualifications.
